review_notes: I read the whole target file. It declares no simp lemmas of its own; the lemmas are private and are used through explicit rw/simp only. The simp interface it depends on is in Restriction.lean and Completion.lean, and I read the relevant declarations there. The one concrete issue is that the pointwise form of the restriction/structure-map compatibility is missing from the simp set. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim that simp fails on any goal. I found no rewrite-cycle or competing-rule problems in the file.

findings.problem: The compatibility of the restriction map with the structure maps is only available as the simp lemma `restrictionRingHom_comp_toCompletionLoc`. It states an equation of `RingHom.comp`, so it cannot fire on the applied term `restrictionRingHom … (toCompletionLoc … a)`. Every use here first folds the application back with `← RingHom.comp_apply`, at lines 498, 501, 525, 624, 772 and 776, and does so in `rw` or `simp only` rather than plain `simp`. Adding `← RingHom.comp_apply` to a `simp` call would fight the default simp lemma `RingHom.comp_apply`. `Iterated.lean` line 281 repeats the same two-step idiom in its own `hρ`. The pointwise form is also not obtained from simp automatically: `toCompletionLoc_apply` is `@[simp]` and unfolds the structure map to a coercion of `algebraMap`. `restrictionRingHom_coe` then rewrites that coercion to an `IsLocalization.Away.lift` term, so the two sides are no longer in the canonical `toCompletionLoc` form.
findings.proposed_change: In Restriction.lean, next to `restrictionRingHom_comp_toCompletionLoc`, add the pointwise statement `restrictionRingHom P T s S hden T'' s'' S'' hden'' r hs'' hT (toCompletionLoc P T s S hden a) = toCompletionLoc P T'' s'' S'' hden'' a` (the `letI` boilerplate stays as in the existing lemma). Its proof is `RingHom.congr_fun (restrictionRingHom_comp_toCompletionLoc …) a`. Mark it `@[simp]`, and consider `@[simp, grind =]`. Keep `toCompletionLoc` as the normal form for images of `A`, for example by giving the new lemma higher priority than the `restrictionRingHom_coe` path. Then replace the `rw [..., ← RingHom.comp_apply, restrictionRingHom_comp_toCompletionLoc]` steps and the `simpa only [..., ← RingHom.comp_apply, ...]` calls with the new lemma, via `simp` or `rw`.
findings.benefit: Removes the repeated `← RingHom.comp_apply` workaround from at least six places in this file and from `Iterated.lean`. `simp` would then close the goal `restriction (toCompletionLoc a) = toCompletionLoc a` directly. The rule would be keyed on an applied `restrictionRingHom`, so it cannot loop with `RingHom.comp_apply`, and the normal form of structure-map images stays `toCompletionLoc`.
